title.zh: Soneium 宣布发行生态代币 SONEIUM 并推出 ipUSD 与 IP Vault 等链上 IP 经济产品
title.en: Soneium plans to issue ecosystem token SONEIUM and build on-chain IP economy

current_state.zh: 索尼旗下 L2 网络 Soneium 推出 ipUSD 稳定币和 IP Vault，让合格用户接触由 Partners Group 管理、规模 5.49 亿美元的音乐与娱乐版税基金，预计年化收益率为 7–9%。
current_state.en: Sony's Soneium L2 launched the ipUSD stablecoin and IP Vault, giving qualified users exposure to a $549M music and entertainment royalty fund managed by Partners Group with an estimated 7–9% annual yield.

updates.title_zh: Soneium计划推出原生生态代币SONEIUM，并布局IP代币化
updates.title_en: Soneium计划推出原生生态代币SONEIUM，并布局IP代币化
updates.what_changed_zh: Soneium 宣布将发行原生生态代币 SONEIUM，并构建链上 IP 经济，包括用于 IP 发行和版税分配的 Portal、IP Vault 和 IP Bond 投资产品，首批合作伙伴包括日本 Moriusa 角色 IP 和韩国 K-pop 公司 DayOneDream。
updates.what_changed_en: Soneium announced it will issue a native ecosystem token, SONEIUM, and build out an on-chain IP economy with a Portal for IP issuance and royalty distribution, IP Vault and IP Bond investment products, and initial partners including Japan's Moriusa character IP and Korean K-pop firm DayOneDream.
